title: RegoMender: A Multi-agent Framework for Automated Rego Policy Repair
title_zh: RegoMender：用于自动化Rego策略修复的多智能体框架

paragraphs.en: Policy-as-Code (PaC) has emerged as a foundational paradigm in cloud-native systems. However, repairing Rego policies remains challenging due to their strict syntax, declarative semantics, and specific verification requirements. Existing automated program repair (APR) methods are mainly designed for mainstream languages and struggle to accommodate the unique policy logic and repair workflows of Rego. Thus, Rego policy repair remains a manual process driven by trial and error. To address this, we introduce RegoBench, the first automated Rego policy benchmark comprising 1,159 real-world defects, and propose RegoMender, a feedback-guided multi-agent framework. Collaborating via a shared blackboard and an atomic toolkit, RegoMender dynamically executes patching, rewriting, or rolling back, to resolve complex repair scenarios. Evaluated on RegoBench, RegoMender achieves syntactic and test-based semantic success rates of 82.9% and 77.9%, respectively, outperforming the strongest baseline by 13.4%. Unlike other approaches whose performance drops in complex scenarios, RegoMender maintains effectiveness across single-step and chained repair tasks. Furthermore, it generalizes strongly across HCL and SQL and achieves an 86.4% repair rate on 132 real-world CVE vulnerabilities, proving its robustness and practical utility for security.

paragraphs.en: Policy-as-Code has become a core paradigm for enforcing security and compliance requirements in cloud-native systems. It represents policies as executable rules that are continuously evaluated against structured artifacts, such as API requests, configuration objects, and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) plans, across both delivery and runtime environments. A widely adopted implementation of PaC is Open Policy Agent (OPA), which separates policy logic from application code and provides a unified evaluation framework across heterogeneous platforms. In practice, OPA is integrated into CI/CD pipelines for pre-deployment validation and into Kubernetes admission control to prevent non-compliant resource updates. OPA policies are written in Rego, a declarative language designed to express policy rules over inputs and produce authorization decisions ( Open Policy Agent (OPA), ) .
paragraphs.zh: 策略即代码（Policy-as-Code）已成为云原生系统中实施安全与合规要求的核心范式。 它将策略表示为可执行规则，并在交付与运行时环境中针对结构化工件（如 API 请求、配置对象和基础设施即代码（IaC）计划）持续进行评估。 策略即代码（PaC）的一种被广泛采用的实现是 Open Policy Agent（OPA），它将策略逻辑与应用代码分离，并在异构平台上提供统一的评估框架。 在实践中，OPA 被集成到 CI/CD 流水线中以进行部署前验证，并被集成到 Kubernetes 准入控制中以阻止不合规的资源更新。 OPA 的策略使用 Rego 编写，Rego 是一种声明式语言，旨在针对输入表达策略规则并产生授权决策（ Open Policy Agent (OPA), ）。

paragraphs.en: However, repairing Rego policies is particularly challenging because of their declarative semantics and strict validation requirements. Unlike imperative languages, Rego follows a logic programming paradigm derived from Datalog, where unification combines pattern matching with variable binding. This context sensitivity means that even a seemingly simple modification may unintentionally alter the logic of the policy. Furthermore, policy evaluation may return undefined when certain data paths are missing. Rather than raising an error, this result may cause conditions to be skipped.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，由于 Rego 策略具有声明式语义和严格的验证要求，修复这类策略尤其具有挑战性。 与命令式语言不同，Rego 遵循源自 Datalog 的逻辑编程范式，其中合一操作将模式匹配与变量绑定结合在一起。 这种上下文敏感性意味着，即使是看似简单的修改，也可能在无意中改变策略的逻辑。 此外，当某些数据路径缺失时，策略求值可能返回未定义（undefined）。 这一结果不会引发错误，而可能导致某些条件被跳过。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, the current APR benchmarks ( Ye et al., 2025 ; Saavedra et al., 2025 ; Just et al., 2014 ; Jimenez et al., 2024 ) have been developed primarily for mainstream programming languages and rely on test suites as correctness oracles. Classic datasets such as Defects4J ( Just et al., 2014 ) provide standardized collections of real-world Java bugs with regression tests, while repository-level benchmarks like SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) evaluate issue resolution in large-scale Python repositories, collectively advancing research in APR. However, dedicated benchmarks for evaluating the automated repair of Rego policies are absent. Unlike conventional programs, policies written in Rego are validated through a tool-driven workflow that includes linting and compilation, policy-specific testing, and compliance checks derived from domain requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，现有的 APR 基准（Ye et al., 2025；Saavedra et al., 2025；Just et al., 2014；Jimenez et al., 2024）主要是为主流编程语言开发的，并依赖测试套件作为正确性判定依据。 诸如 Defects4J（Just et al., 2014）之类的经典数据集提供了带有回归测试的真实世界 Java 缺陷的标准化集合，而像 SWE-bench（Jimenez et al., 2024）这样的仓库级基准则评估大规模 Python 仓库中的问题解决能力，这些工作共同推动了 APR 研究的进展。 然而，目前缺少专门用于评估 Rego 策略自动化修复的基准。 与传统程序不同，用 Rego 编写的策略通过一个由工具驱动的工作流进行验证，该工作流包括代码检查与编译、策略专用测试，以及源自领域需求的合规性检查。

paragraphs.en: This mismatch presents two fundamental challenges for the automated repair of Rego policies: (i) Lack of benchmarks for Rego repair. To date, there is no publicly available dataset specifically designed for Rego policy repair, making it difficult to systematically evaluate whether existing APR or LLM-based approaches can effectively handle Rego-specific syntax, semantics, and verification workflows. (ii) Heavy reliance on manual or ad hoc LLM-based repair workflows. In practice, Rego policy repair still relies heavily on manual debugging by domain experts or on ad hoc interactions with LLMs , developers must manually interpret policy failures, construct prompts, invoke opa check and opa test , assess the verification outcomes, and iteratively revise candidate patches. This human-in-the-loop repair process is time-consuming, error-prone, and difficult to scale, especially when repairs must preserve repository-specific policy intent and compliance semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 这种错配给 Rego 策略的自动修复带来了两个根本性挑战：(i) 缺乏 Rego 修复的基准测试。 迄今为止，尚无专门针对 Rego 策略修复的公开可用数据集，因此难以系统性地评估现有的 APR 或基于 LLM 的方法能否有效处理 Rego 特有的语法、语义和验证工作流。 (ii) 严重依赖人工或临时的基于 LLM 的修复工作流。 在实践中，Rego 策略修复仍然严重依赖领域专家的人工调试或与 LLM 的临时交互，开发者必须手动解读策略失败原因、构造提示词、调用 opa check 和 opa test、评估验证结果，并迭代修改候选补丁。 这种人在回路中的修复过程耗时、易错且难以扩展，尤其是当修复必须保留特定代码仓库的策略意图与合规语义时更是如此。

paragraphs.en: To address the lack of systematic data and reproducible evaluation for Rego policy repair, we mine real-world defect fixes from 2,847 GitHub repositories that actively maintain Rego policies. We then design a strict three-stage filtering pipeline to progressively refine the raw commit-level candidates, including isolated patch extraction, redundancy and noise mitigation, and deterministic verification under a standardized OPA toolchain. This process yields 1,159 high-quality buggy-fix pairs that are fully reproducible. This benchmark covers seven OPA-derived defect types, preserves the natural difficulty distribution of real-world defects and features a high proportion of complex chained repairs, directly measuring how well repair methods handle practical programming tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决 Rego 策略修复缺乏系统性数据和可复现评测的问题，我们从 2,847 个积极维护 Rego 策略的 GitHub 仓库中挖掘真实世界的缺陷修复。 随后，我们设计了一个严格的三阶段过滤流水线，逐步精炼原始的提交级候选数据，包括隔离补丁提取、冗余与噪声消减，以及在标准化 OPA 工具链下的确定性验证。 该过程最终产出 1,159 对完全可复现的高质量缺陷-修复对。 该基准涵盖七种 OPA 衍生的缺陷类型，保留了真实世界缺陷的自然难度分布，并具有较高比例的复杂链式修复，可直接衡量修复方法处理实际编程任务的能力。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, we design RegoMender, a multi-agent framework for automated Rego policy repair. RegoMender establishes a closed loop between code repair and OPA verification by coordinating three specialized roles, namely the Orchestrator, Analyzer, and Repairer, through a shared Blackboard and an auditable atomic toolkit. Specifically, all repository interactions are carried out through the atomic toolkit, which provides five core operations: Verify , Context Scan , Error Triage , Rewrite , and Patch . This design ensures that each repair step remains precise and reproducible. Guided by real-time verifier feedback, the Orchestrator coordinates the Analyzer and Repairer, records progress on the Blackboard, and rolls back when necessary to avoid stagnation. In this way, RegoMender supports reliable multi-step repair, particularly in cases where resolving one failure exposes additional hidden defects.

sents.en: Guided by real-time verifier feedback, the Orchestrator coordinates the Analyzer and Repairer, records progress on the Blackboard, and rolls back when necessary to avoid stagnation.

sents.en: In this way, RegoMender supports reliable multi-step repair, particularly in cases where resolving one failure exposes additional hidden defects.
sents.zh: 通过这种方式，RegoMender 支持可靠的多步修复，尤其是在解决某一故障后暴露出更多隐藏缺陷的情况下。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of RegoMender, we conduct extensive experiments on RegoBench. First, the results show that, compared to existing automated program repair methods ( Yin et al., 2024 ; Bouzenia et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2025a ) , RegoMender achieves syntactic and test-based semantic success rates of 82.9% and 77.9%, respectively. It ranks first across all seven defect types, demonstrating the effectiveness of our agent orchestration and task decision-making mechanisms. Second, we analyze the impact of different backbone models on RegoMender and the baselines. We find that RegoMender demonstrates superior robustness across different models , and DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus ( Liu et al., 2024 ) provides the best balance between performance and cost. Third, we conduct a comparative study on single-step and chained repair tasks. We find that RegoMender maintains stable performance in both situations. Furthermore, we conduct an ablation study on the designed atomic toolkit. The results reveal that the Context Scan tool has the most significant impact on the framework’s performance. This indicates that the repair process for the Rego policies relies on context gathering . To evaluate its cross-language generalizability, we extend our method to two additional domain-specific languages (HCL and SQL). The results show that RegoMender continues to maintain a significant advantage over other baselines. Finally, to verify its practical utility in the real world, we evaluate our method on 132 CVE vulnerabilities. RegoMender achieves a repair rate of 86.4%, outperforming ThinkRepair and RepairAgent and demonstrating its practical potential for security-related repair.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估 RegoMender 的有效性，我们在 RegoBench 上进行了大量实验。 首先，结果表明，与现有的自动化程序修复方法（Yin et al., 2024; Bouzenia et al., 2025; Xia et al., 2024; Hu et al., 2025a）相比，RegoMender 的语法成功率和基于测试的语义成功率分别为 82.9% 和 77.9%。 它在全部七种缺陷类型上均排名第一，证明了我们智能体编排与任务决策机制的有效性。 其次，我们分析了不同骨干模型对 RegoMender 以及各基线方法的影响。 我们发现 RegoMender 在不同模型上都展现出优越的鲁棒性，而 DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus（Liu et al., 2024）在性能与成本之间提供了最佳平衡。 第三，我们对单步修复任务和链式修复任务进行了对比研究。 我们发现 RegoMender 在两种情况下都能保持稳定的性能。 此外，我们对所设计的原子工具包进行了消融实验。 结果显示，Context Scan 工具对框架性能的影响最为显著。 这表明 Rego 策略的修复过程依赖于上下文收集。 为了评估其跨语言泛化能力，我们将方法扩展到另外两种领域特定语言（HCL 和 SQL）。 结果表明，RegoMender 相较于其他基线方法仍然保持显著优势。 最后，为了验证其在真实世界中的实用价值，我们在 132 个 CVE 漏洞上评估了我们的方法。 RegoMender 达到了 86.4% 的修复率，优于 ThinkRepair 和 RepairAgent，展现了其在安全相关修复方面的实用潜力。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 shows a motivating example of Rego policy repair. In Figure 1 (a), the buggy rule uses unification ( = ) and directly reads input.request.object.metadata.labels after checking that the resource kind is "Pod" . Under Rego’s undefined-value semantics, if the labels field is absent or the binding fails, the rule body may become undefined , so the intended deny decision is not produced. In Figure 1 (b), the repair uses explicit comparison ( == ) for the kind check, retrieves labels with object.get(input...metadata, "labels", ) , and uses strict assignment ( := ) for derived values. These changes handle missing labels explicitly and restore a well-defined admission decision. This example shows why Rego repair is language-specific. The operators = , := , and == represent unification, assignment, and comparison rather than simple symbol replacements, and whether an input path is defined depends on the runtime context. Therefore, Rego repairs should be validated with the standard OPA toolchain ( opa check and opa test ) to avoid deployment failures. Current LLMs also have limited experience with Rego repair because repair data remains scarce, making reliable decisions from prior patterns difficult.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 展示了一个 Rego 策略修复的动机示例。 在图 1 (a) 中，有缺陷的规则使用统一（ = ）并在检查资源类型为 "Pod" 之后直接读取 input.request.object.metadata.labels 。 在 Rego 的未定义值语义下，如果 labels 字段缺失或绑定失败，规则体可能变为 undefined ，从而无法产生预期的拒绝决策。 在图 1 (b) 中，修复方案对类型检查使用显式比较（ == ），通过 object.get(input...metadata, "labels", ) 获取 labels ，并对派生值使用严格赋值（ := ）。 这些改动显式地处理了 labels 缺失的情况，并恢复了一个良定义的准入决策。 这个示例说明了为什么 Rego 修复是特定于语言的。 运算符 = 、 := 和 == 分别表示统一、赋值和比较，而非简单的符号替换，且某个输入路径是否有定义取决于运行时上下文。 因此，Rego 修复应当使用标准 OPA 工具链（ opa check 和 opa test ）进行验证，以避免部署失败。 当前的大语言模型在 Rego 修复方面的经验也很有限，因为修复数据仍然稀缺，难以依据既有模式做出可靠的决策。

paragraphs.en: Based on the above analysis, we construct RegoBench, a benchmark of 1,159 Rego repair instances covering a broad range of syntax and semantic errors, and propose RegoMender, a multi-agent framework for automated Rego policy repair. Recent software engineering systems use specialized agents for planning, analysis, coding, and tool use ( He et al., 2025 ; Qian et al., 2024 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Tufano et al., 2024 ) . However, such collaboration does not directly address Rego-specific needs in policy semantics, context extraction, and OPA-based verification. To address these needs, our framework coordinates three specialized agents via a shared toolkit and blackboard for automated Rego policy repair.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we first describe the construction of the proposed benchmark, RegoBench (§ 3.1 ), followed by a detailed presentation of our multi-agent repair framework, RegoMender (§ 3.2 ).

paragraphs.en: We construct RegoBench, the first benchmark dedicated to real-world Rego defects, follows three main steps. First, we define each repair instance and the evaluation criteria for a successful repair. Next, we execute the data filtering process to collect high-quality instances from open-source repositories. Finally, we classify the benchmark along several characteristic dimensions to provide a comprehensive overview of the dataset.

paragraphs.en: Code Pair. We store two versions of the policy code: C b ​ u ​ g C_{bug} and C f ​ i ​ x C_{fix} . Alongside the raw code, we record metadata, such as the commit hash, repository link, and relative file paths. This information enables the precise historical code state to be retrieved and replayed deterministically.

paragraphs.en: To construct the initial corpus, we query the GitHub Search API for repositories containing .rego files. To ensure data quality and relevance, we apply a strict activity filter, retaining only repositories with at least 40 commits between January 1, 2020, and June 30, 2024. This yields 2,847 qualified repositories. We then analyze their commit histories to extract potential defect repairs, resulting in 54,821 raw candidates. However, extracting these defects from open source repositories introduces noise. Specifically, we observe four patterns of invalid repairs. First, superficial fixes occur when commits labeled as repairs consist only of formatting changes or code refactoring. Second, invalid repairs occur when developers simply delete code to pass checks without fixing the actual defect. Third, coupling across files scatters the repair logic across multiple formats, such as Rego, YAML, and Go, making it difficult to isolate the core defect. Fourth, environmental instability arises when failures depend on external variables or continuous integration contexts that are difficult to reproduce. We therefore design a three-stage filtering pipeline to obtain a high-quality dataset.
paragraphs.zh: 为了构建初始语料库，我们通过 GitHub Search API 查询包含 .rego 文件的仓库。 为确保数据质量与相关性，我们应用严格的活跃度过滤条件，仅保留在2020年1月1日至2024年6月30日期间至少有40次提交的仓库。 由此得到2,847个符合条件的仓库。 随后，我们分析这些仓库的提交历史以提取潜在的缺陷修复，得到54,821个原始候选。 然而，从开源仓库中提取这些缺陷会引入噪声。 具体而言，我们观察到四种无效修复的模式。 第一，表层修复指被标记为修复的提交仅包含格式更改或代码重构。 第二，无效修复指开发者仅通过删除代码来通过检查，而未修复实际缺陷。 第三，跨文件耦合将修复逻辑分散在多种格式中，如 Rego、YAML 和 Go，使得难以隔离核心缺陷。 第四，环境不稳定性指故障依赖于难以复现的外部变量或持续集成环境。 因此，我们设计了一个三阶段过滤流水线，以获得高质量数据集。

paragraphs.en: 1) Isolated Patch Extraction. To resolve coupling across files, we enforce a strict single-file pairing rule. Only commits with substantive edits confined to a single .rego file are retained, ensuring a clear mapping between the defective and fixed states at the same file path. Nonfunctional edits are discarded to ensure each instance represents a meaningful repair. This filtering step reduces the raw corpus from 54,821 to 8,643 candidates.
paragraphs.zh: 1) 孤立补丁提取。 为了解决跨文件的耦合问题，我们强制执行严格的单文件配对规则。 仅保留实质性编辑局限于单个 .rego 文件的提交，从而确保同一文件路径下缺陷状态与修复状态之间的清晰映射。 非功能性编辑会被丢弃，以确保每个实例都代表一次有意义的修复。 该过滤步骤将原始语料库从 54,821 个候选缩减至 8,643 个候选。

paragraphs.en: 2) Redundancy & Noise Mitigation. To reduce noise from repetitive patches, we implement a clear deduplication strategy. We first exclude forked and archived repositories and then use file fingerprints, defined by the repository, commit hash, and file path, to prevent redundant processing. Additionally, we apply content hashing to eliminate identical code copies caused by version control operations. Finally, we manually audit the dataset to discard samples where the link between the code change and the verification result is unclear. Through this process, we retain 3,071 candidates.
paragraphs.zh: 2) 冗余与噪声消除。 为了减少重复补丁带来的噪声，我们实施了一种明确的去重策略。 我们首先排除分叉（fork）和已归档的仓库，然后使用由仓库、提交哈希和文件路径定义的文件指纹，以防止冗余处理。 此外，我们应用内容哈希来消除由版本控制操作导致的相同代码副本。 最后，我们对数据集进行人工审核，丢弃代码变更与验证结果之间联系不清晰的样本。 通过这一流程，我们保留了 3,071 个候选样本。

paragraphs.en: 3) Two-Tier Oracle Verification. Finally, to ensure reproducibility and eliminate environmental inconsistencies, we establish a deterministic two-tier verification process using the standard OPA toolchain. Each retained instance must satisfy strict evaluation criteria. First, the defective policy must trigger a verifiable failure (via either opa check or opa test ) to confirm the presence of a bug. Second, the developer fix must successfully pass both verification tiers. This process guarantees that every accepted instance is both syntactically valid and behaviorally correct.
paragraphs.zh: 3）两层 Oracle 验证。 最后，为确保可复现性并消除环境不一致性，我们使用标准 OPA 工具链建立了一个确定性的两层验证流程。 每个保留的实例都必须满足严格的评估标准。 首先，缺陷策略必须触发可验证的失败（通过 opa check 或 opa test），以确认缺陷的存在。 其次，开发者的修复必须成功通过两个验证层级。 这一流程保证了每个被接受的实例在语法上有效且行为上正确。

paragraphs.en: Following this three-stage filtering pipeline, we refine the raw data into a dataset of 1,159 high-quality and reproducible instances.
paragraphs.zh: 经过这一三阶段筛选流程后，我们将原始数据精炼为包含 1,159 个高质量且可复现实例的数据集。

paragraphs.en: Following standard practices ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Just et al., 2014 ; Le Goues et al., 2015 ; Saha et al., 2018 ) in benchmark construction, we preserve the natural distribution of the filtered dataset. To characterize this dataset, we classify the repair difficulty into three levels: easy, medium, and hard. We then engage three senior developers to manually evaluate and classify the 1,159 repair instances. To measure the consistency of their independent evaluations, we calculate the Fleiss’ Kappa ( Fleiss, 1971 ) statistic. The resulting score is 0.85, which indicates an almost perfect agreement among the three developers. For the few instances with conflicting classifications, the developers hold discussions to review the instances and reach a final consensus. The labeling results reveal that 518 instances fall into the easy category, 372 into the medium category, and 269 into the hard category. This proportion is consistent with previous empirical findings ( Karampatsis and Sutton, 2020 ; Purushothaman and Perry, 2005 ; Zhong and Su, 2015 ) , confirming that real software defects naturally concentrate on simpler errors.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循基准构建中的标准做法（Jimenez et al., 2024；Just et al., 2014；Le Goues et al., 2015；Saha et al., 2018），我们保留了筛选后数据集的自然分布。 为刻画该数据集，我们将修复难度划分为三个等级：简单、中等和困难。 随后，我们邀请三位资深开发人员对这1,159个修复实例进行人工评估和分类。 为衡量他们各自独立评估的一致性，我们计算了Fleiss' Kappa（Fleiss, 1971）统计量。 所得分数为0.85，表明三位开发人员之间几乎完全一致。 对于少数分类存在冲突的实例，开发人员通过讨论复审这些实例并达成最终共识。 标注结果显示，518个实例属于简单类别，372个属于中等类别，269个属于困难类别。 这一比例与以往的经验性研究结果一致（Karampatsis and Sutton, 2020；Purushothaman and Perry, 2005；Zhong and Su, 2015），证实真实软件缺陷自然集中于较为简单的错误。

paragraphs.en: Beyond repair difficulty, we characterize the benchmark by repair dependency, categorizing instances as single-step or chained repairs. Specifically, an instance is classified as single-step if the initial error category remains unchanged until the repair successfully passes both evaluation tiers. In contrast, an instance is labeled as chained if resolving the initial error exposes at least one subsequent error category before overall success. Based on this error-driven definition, 698 instances are chained repairs and the remaining 461 are single-step repairs, as shown in Figure 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 除修复难度外，我们还从修复依赖性的角度刻画该基准，将实例分为单步修复和链式修复两类。 具体而言，如果初始错误类别在修复成功通过两个评估层级之前保持不变，则该实例被归类为单步修复。 相反，如果在整体成功之前，解决初始错误又暴露出至少一个后续错误类别，则该实例被标记为链式修复。 基于这一由错误驱动的定义，如图2所示，698个实例为链式修复，其余461个为单步修复。

paragraphs.en: RegoMender is an automated multi-agent framework designed for repairing Rego policies. As shown in Figure 2 , our approach centers on an Orchestrator that manages a continuous feedback loop driven by the results of opa check and opa test . The Orchestrator coordinates two specialized agents, namely the Analyzer and the Repairer, using a shared blackboard to exchange state information. To make precise code changes and prevent the repair process from getting stuck, RegoMender includes an atomic repair toolkit, as well as a mechanism for stagnation detection and rollback. We detail these core components and the overall execution workflow below.
paragraphs.zh: RegoMender 是一个用于修复 Rego 策略的自动化多智能体框架。 如图 2 所示，我们的方法以一个编排器（Orchestrator）为核心，它管理着一个由 opa check 和 opa test 的结果驱动的持续反馈循环。 编排器协调两个专门的智能体，即分析器（Analyzer）和修复器（Repairer），并使用共享黑板来交换状态信息。 为了进行精确的代码修改并防止修复过程陷入停滞，RegoMender 包含一个原子修复工具包，以及一个停滞检测与回滚机制。 我们将在下文详细介绍这些核心组件以及整体执行工作流。

sents.zh: 如图 2 所示，我们的方法以一个编排器（Orchestrator）为核心，它管理着一个由 opa check 和 opa test 的结果驱动的持续反馈循环。

sents.en: The Orchestrator coordinates two specialized agents, namely the Analyzer and the Repairer, using a shared blackboard to exchange state information.
sents.zh: 编排器协调两个专门的智能体，即分析器（Analyzer）和修复器（Repairer），并使用共享黑板来交换状态信息。

sents.en: To make precise code changes and prevent the repair process from getting stuck, RegoMender includes an atomic repair toolkit, as well as a mechanism for stagnation detection and rollback.
sents.zh: 为了进行精确的代码修改并防止修复过程陷入停滞，RegoMender 包含一个原子修复工具包，以及一个停滞检测与回滚机制。

sents.en: We detail these core components and the overall execution workflow below.
sents.zh: 我们将在下文详细介绍这些核心组件以及整体执行工作流。

paragraphs.en: Each part RegoMender takes on a distinct role to ensure a smooth repair process. We outline their specific tasks and internal logic below.

sents.en: Atomic Repair Toolkit.
sents.zh: 原子修复工具集。

sents.en: To make the system behavior auditable and reproducible, we abstract all operations into five atomic tools.
sents.zh: 为了使系统行为可审计、可复现，我们将所有操作抽象为五个原子工具。

sents.en: These tools serve as the sole interface for the agents:
sents.zh: 这些工具是智能体的唯一接口：

paragraphs.en: Verify: Provides the system source of truth by running syntax and semantic checks to return a formal set of errors.
paragraphs.zh: 验证：通过运行语法和语义检查来提供系统的可信源，并返回一组正式的错误。

paragraphs.en: Context Scan: Extracts an abstract syntax tree and a dependency graph from the current policy to help agents understand the available variables and packages.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文扫描：从当前策略中提取抽象语法树和依赖图，帮助智能体了解可用的变量和包。

paragraphs.en: Error Triage: Converts raw error information into a structured format containing the error category, line location, and the specific message associated with each line.
paragraphs.zh: 错误分诊：将原始错误信息转换为包含错误类别、行位置以及与每一行相关的具体消息的结构化格式。

paragraphs.en: Patch: Conducts corrections on individual code lines, such as modifying a variable name, flipping a logical operator, or refining a specific policy constraint.
paragraphs.zh: 补丁：对单个代码行进行修正，例如修改变量名、翻转逻辑运算符或完善特定的策略约束。

paragraphs.en: Rewrite: Replaces entire policy blocks or regenerates complex logic when simple edits are insufficient.
paragraphs.zh: 重写：当简单编辑不够时，替换整个策略块或重新生成复杂逻辑。

paragraphs.en: Blackboard. To reduce context loss in multi-agent collaboration, RegoMender uses a structured shared blackboard as the central repository for the system state. This component contains three fields: (i) the Code Field, which maintains a versioned history of the Rego code, allowing the system to retrieve previous code snapshots for rollback; (ii) the Report Field, which stores the sequence of structured diagnostic reports generated by the Analyzer, including the error category, line location, corresponding error message, relevant context information extracted by the Context Scan tool, and a priority value to guide the Repairer in fixing critical issues first; and (iii) the Error Signature Field, which maintains a tuple ⟨ Error Category , Error Count , Error Streak ⟩ \langle\textit{Error Category},\textit{Error Count},\textit{Error Streak}\rangle . We define the first two elements as a state ( s ​ t ​ a ​ t ​ e = ⟨ Error Category , Error Count ⟩ ) (state=\langle\textit{Error Category},\textit{Error Count}\rangle) , which serves as the main signal for agent routing. The Error Streak then records the number of consecutive occurrences of the same s ​ t ​ a ​ t ​ e state . This allows the Orchestrator to monitor the persistence of failure patterns, enabling it to trigger rollbacks or strategy adjustments.
paragraphs.zh: 黑板。 为了减少多智能体协作中的上下文丢失，RegoMender 使用一个结构化的共享黑板作为系统状态的中央存储库。 该组件包含三个字段：(i) 代码字段，维护 Rego 代码的版本历史，允许系统检索先前的代码快照以进行回滚；(ii) 报告字段，存储由分析器生成的结构化诊断报告序列，包括错误类别、行位置、对应的错误信息、由上下文扫描工具提取的相关上下文信息，以及用于引导修复器优先修复关键问题的优先级值；(iii) 错误签名字段，维护一个元组 ⟨ Error Category , Error Count , Error Streak ⟩ \langle\textit{Error Category},\textit{Error Count},\textit{Error Streak}\rangle。 我们将前两个元素定义为状态 ( s ​ t ​ a ​ t ​ e = ⟨ Error Category , Error Count ⟩ ) (state=\langle\textit{Error Category},\textit{Error Count}\rangle)，它作为智能体路由的主要信号。 Error Streak 则记录相同 s ​ t ​ a ​ t ​ e state 连续出现的次数。 这使得编排器能够监控失败模式的持续性，从而触发回滚或策略调整。

paragraphs.en: Orchestrator. The Orchestrator serves as the decision-maker and quality controller of RegoMender. It does not generate code directly but coordinates the workflow by dispatching tasks to the Analyzer or the Repairer. Its strategy is determined by a decision rule π ⁡ ( 𝑛𝑒𝑥𝑡 ∣ 𝑠𝑡𝑎𝑡𝑒 ) \pi(\mathit{next}\mid\mathit{state}) , where 𝑛𝑒𝑥𝑡 ∈ { 𝐴𝑛𝑎𝑙𝑦𝑧𝑒𝑟 , 𝑅𝑒𝑝𝑎𝑖𝑟𝑒𝑟 , 𝑅𝑜𝑙𝑙𝑏𝑎𝑐𝑘 , 𝐷𝑜𝑛𝑒 } \mathit{next}\in\{\mathit{Analyzer},\mathit{Repairer},\mathit{Rollback},\mathit{Done}\} and state captures the current error category and count. In each iteration, the Orchestrator retrieves the latest code from the Blackboard and invokes the Verify tool. If verification fails, the Orchestrator updates the Error Signature and selects the next action based on the current repair state and explicit routing conditions defined in its prompt. Localized failures with clear line-level diagnostics are treated as simple errors and sent directly to the Repairer. Ambiguous, dependency-related, or repeatedly unresolved failures are treated as complex errors and sent to the Analyzer for additional context and dependency analysis before repair. After each repair, the Orchestrator invokes Verify again. A changed state indicates progress and resets the Error Streak, whereas an unchanged state triggers a revised diagnosis from the Analyzer. Once the predefined stagnation threshold is reached, the Orchestrator rolls back to the snapshot saved before the stalled attempts and requests a new diagnosis. The workflow concludes as 𝐷𝑜𝑛𝑒 \mathit{Done} only after the policy passes both syntactic and semantic validation. To prevent infinite loops, the Orchestrator monitors the repair progress and stops the process if the maximum iteration limit is reached.
paragraphs.zh: 编排器（Orchestrator）。 编排器充当 RegoMender 的决策者和质量控制者。 它不直接生成代码，而是通过向分析器（Analyzer）或修复器（Repairer）分派任务来协调工作流。 其策略由决策规则 π ⁡ ( 𝑛𝑒𝑥𝑡 ∣ 𝑠𝑡𝑎𝑡𝑒 ) \pi(\mathit{next}\mid\mathit{state}) 决定，其中 𝑛𝑒𝑥𝑡 ∈ { 𝐴𝑛𝑎𝑙𝑦𝑧𝑒𝑟 , 𝑅𝑒𝑝𝑎𝑖𝑟𝑒𝑟 , 𝑅𝑜𝑙𝑙𝑏𝑎𝑐𝑘 , 𝐷𝑜𝑛𝑒 } \mathit{next}\in\{\mathit{Analyzer},\mathit{Repairer},\mathit{Rollback},\mathit{Done}\}，而 state 记录当前的错误类别和计数。 在每次迭代中，编排器从黑板（Blackboard）获取最新代码并调用 Verify 工具。 如果验证失败，编排器会更新错误签名（Error Signature），并根据当前修复状态以及其提示词中定义的显式路由条件选择下一步动作。 具有清晰行级诊断信息的局部性失败被视为简单错误，并直接发送给修复器。 模糊的、与依赖相关的或反复未能解决的失败被视为复杂错误，在修复之前发送给分析器以获取额外的上下文和依赖分析。 每次修复之后，编排器会再次调用 Verify。 状态发生变化表示取得了进展并会重置错误连击计数（Error Streak），而状态未变化则会触发分析器进行修订诊断。 一旦达到预定义的停滞阈值，编排器会回滚到停滞尝试之前保存的快照，并请求新的诊断。 只有当策略同时通过语法和语义验证后，工作流才以 𝐷𝑜𝑛𝑒 \mathit{Done} 结束。 为防止无限循环，编排器会监控修复进度，并在达到最大迭代限制时停止该过程。

paragraphs.en: Analyzer. The Analyzer acts as the diagnostic specialist, engaged by the Orchestrator when error messages are too complex or ambiguous for direct repair. Upon receiving this task, it retrieves the latest error stream and uses the Error Triage tool to extract a structured error description, mapping each error to its category, line location, and corresponding message. At the same time, the Context Scan tool extracts context and dependency information for the identified code region. The Analyzer then analyzes each error to infer its underlying cause and synthesizes these findings into a diagnostic report written to the shared blackboard.
paragraphs.zh: 分析器。 分析器充当诊断专家，当错误信息过于复杂或模糊而无法直接修复时，由编排器调用它。 接到该任务后，它获取最新的错误流，并使用错误分诊工具提取结构化的错误描述，将每个错误映射到其类别、行位置及对应的消息。 与此同时，上下文扫描工具为所识别的代码区域提取上下文和依赖信息。 随后，分析器对每个错误进行分析以推断其根本原因，并将这些发现综合成一份诊断报告，写入共享黑板。

paragraphs.en: Stagnation Detection and Rollback Mechanism. To prevent infinite loops caused by complex dependency chains, the Orchestrator continuously monitors repair progress. In our framework, stagnation is defined as a state where no meaningful progress is made. Specifically, we consider the repair progress stalled if the Error Signature remains unchanged for 5 consecutive iterations ( τ = 5 \tau=5 ). When this happens, the Orchestrator triggers a rollback by retrieving the Rego code snapshot from the Blackboard that existed before the stagnation began. It then dispatches the Analyzer to review the historical reports stored on the Blackboard and reflect on why the previous attempts failed. Instead of a standard analysis, the Analyzer re-evaluates the persistent errors and their dependencies to issue a revised diagnostic report. This allows the Repairer to change its approach and try a different repair path to find a successful solution.
paragraphs.zh: 停滞检测与回滚机制。 为防止复杂依赖链导致无限循环，Orchestrator（编排器）持续监控修复进度。 在我们的框架中，停滞被定义为未取得任何有意义进展的状态。 具体而言，如果错误签名在连续 5 次迭代中保持不变（ τ = 5 \tau=5 ），我们即认为修复进度陷入停滞。 当这种情况发生时，Orchestrator 通过从 Blackboard（黑板）中获取停滞开始之前存在的 Rego 代码快照来触发回滚。 随后，Orchestrator 会调度 Analyzer（分析器）审查存储在 Blackboard 上的历史报告，并反思之前的尝试为何失败。 Analyzer 不进行标准分析，而是重新评估持续存在的错误及其依赖关系，以发布修订后的诊断报告。 这使得 Repairer（修复器）能够改变其方法，尝试不同的修复路径以找到成功的解决方案。

sents.en: Stagnation Detection and Rollback Mechanism.
sents.zh: 停滞检测与回滚机制。

sents.en: To prevent infinite loops caused by complex dependency chains, the Orchestrator continuously monitors repair progress.
sents.zh: 为防止复杂依赖链导致无限循环，Orchestrator（编排器）持续监控修复进度。

sents.en: In our framework, stagnation is defined as a state where no meaningful progress is made.
sents.zh: 在我们的框架中，停滞被定义为未取得任何有意义进展的状态。

sents.en: Specifically, we consider the repair progress stalled if the Error Signature remains unchanged for 5 consecutive iterations ( τ = 5 \tau=5 ).
sents.zh: 具体而言，如果错误签名在连续 5 次迭代中保持不变（ τ = 5 \tau=5 ），我们即认为修复进度陷入停滞。

sents.en: When this happens, the Orchestrator triggers a rollback by retrieving the Rego code snapshot from the Blackboard that existed before the stagnation began.
sents.zh: 当这种情况发生时，Orchestrator 通过从 Blackboard（黑板）中获取停滞开始之前存在的 Rego 代码快照来触发回滚。

sents.en: It then dispatches the Analyzer to review the historical reports stored on the Blackboard and reflect on why the previous attempts failed.
sents.zh: 随后，Orchestrator 会调度 Analyzer（分析器）审查存储在 Blackboard 上的历史报告，并反思之前的尝试为何失败。

sents.en: Instead of a standard analysis, the Analyzer re-evaluates the persistent errors and their dependencies to issue a revised diagnostic report.
sents.zh: Analyzer 不进行标准分析，而是重新评估持续存在的错误及其依赖关系，以发布修订后的诊断报告。

sents.en: This allows the Repairer to change its approach and try a different repair path to find a successful solution.
sents.zh: 这使得 Repairer（修复器）能够改变其方法，尝试不同的修复路径以找到成功的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: The Orchestrator manages RegoMender as a feedback loop for repairing a faulty Rego repository. It extracts the initial code, stores it in the Code Field of the Blackboard, and invokes the Verify tool on the latest code in each iteration for syntactic and semantic testing. If all tests pass, the workflow terminates as Done . Otherwise, the Orchestrator updates the Error Signature Field and selects the next action based on the current s ​ t ​ a ​ t ​ e state . For simple errors, it dispatches the Repairer to use the Patch or Rewrite tool; for complex errors, it invokes the Analyzer to synthesize raw logs and dependency context into the Report Field. To prevent infinite loops, the Orchestrator tracks the Error Streak . If the s ​ t ​ a ​ t ​ e state remains unchanged for 5 iterations, it rolls back to the snapshot saved prior to the stagnation. The Analyzer then reviews prior reports, revises the diagnostic strategy, and provides fresh guidance to the Repairer. This diagnosis, repair, and verification cycle continues until the policy is repaired or the process reaches the maximum limit of 30 iterations. We set the iteration limit and stagnation threshold based on our practical repair experience to balance repair effectiveness with computational efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: Orchestrator（编排器）将 RegoMender 管理为一个用于修复有缺陷 Rego 仓库的反馈循环。 它提取初始代码，将其存储在黑板（Blackboard）的代码字段（Code Field）中，并在每次迭代中对最新代码调用 Verify 工具进行语法和语义测试。 如果所有测试通过，工作流以 Done 状态终止。 否则，Orchestrator 更新错误签名字段（Error Signature Field），并根据当前的 s ​ t ​ a ​ t ​ e 状态选择下一个动作。 对于简单错误，它调度 Repairer 使用 Patch 或 Rewrite 工具；对于复杂错误，它调用 Analyzer 将原始日志和依赖上下文综合整理进报告字段（Report Field）。 为防止无限循环，Orchestrator 跟踪错误连续次数（Error Streak）。 如果 s ​ t ​ a ​ t ​ e 状态在 5 次迭代内保持不变，它将回滚到停滞前保存的快照。 然后 Analyzer 会审查先前的报告，调整诊断策略，并为 Repairer 提供新的指导。 这一诊断、修复与验证的循环持续进行，直到策略被修复或过程达到 30 次迭代的最大上限。 我们根据实际的修复经验设定迭代上限和停滞阈值，以在修复效果与计算效率之间取得平衡。

paragraphs.en: Standalone Repair Methods. This category includes state-of-the-art (SOTA) automated program repair work tailored for LLMs. Specifically, Agentless ( Xia et al., 2024 ) is a lightweight approach that avoids complex agent loops by using a strict two-phase pipeline of fault localization and patch generation. ThinkRepair ( Yin et al., 2024 ) enhances patch quality by prompting the model to generate a structured thought process before outputting code. APR-MCTS ( Hu et al., 2025a ) integrates LLMs with Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) ( Browne et al., 2012 ) to explore possible patches using test feedback as reward signals, while RepairAgent ( Bouzenia et al., 2025 ) formulates bug fixing as an interactive task where the LLM autonomously gathers context to construct a repair.
paragraphs.zh: 独立修复方法。 这一类包括为大型语言模型（LLM）量身定制的最先进（SOTA）自动程序修复工作。 具体而言，Agentless（Xia et al., 2024）是一种轻量级方法，它通过使用故障定位与补丁生成的严格两阶段流水线，避免了复杂的智能体循环。 ThinkRepair（Yin et al., 2024）通过提示模型在输出代码之前生成结构化的思考过程来提升补丁质量。 APR-MCTS（Hu et al., 2025a）将大型语言模型与蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）（Browne et al., 2012）相结合，利用测试反馈作为奖励信号来探索可能的补丁，而 RepairAgent（Bouzenia et al., 2025）则将缺陷修复表述为一个交互式任务，由大型语言模型自主收集上下文来构建修复。

paragraphs.en: General-Purpose Agent Systems. This category covers general-purpose agent systems designed for repository-level software engineering rather than specifically for automated program repair. It covers both multi-agent strategies and off-the-shelf coding agents. AutoDev ( Tufano et al., 2024 ) uses a conversation manager to coordinate repository-level tasks and execute commands, while MetaGPT ( Hong et al., 2024 ) assigns specialized roles to agents to support collaboration similar to that of a software development team. Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2026 ) and Codex ( OpenAI, 2026a ) are off-the-shelf coding agents that can inspect repository context, modify source files, and execute development tools. We evaluate both coding agents through their official SDKs.

paragraphs.en: Although Tier-2 provides an executable evaluation of policy behavior, the available tests may not cover all intended policy semantics. To strengthen this evaluation, we adopt the LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm ( Gu et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) and use GPT-5.4 ( OpenAI, 2026b ) as a binary semantic judge. The judge is invoked only after a candidate passes Tier-2 and does not participate in repair generation. It classifies the repair as either preserved or changed , based on whether the repair fixes the target defect without introducing unintended changes to the policy behavior. The developer-written fix is provided only to the judge as a reference for the intended behavior.

paragraphs.en: Among the standalone baselines, RepairAgent performs the best, achieving 70.4% on Pass@Tier-1 and 64.5% on Pass@Tier-2, clearly outperforming APR-MCTS, Agentless, and ThinkRepair. This suggests that structured tool use is far more effective for Rego repair than prompting or search alone. However, RegoMender surpasses RepairAgent by a substantial margin of 12.5% on Pass@Tier-1 and 13.4% on Pass@Tier-2. This gap shows that simply providing tools to a single agent is not enough; successful repair depends heavily on dynamic orchestration that can effectively coordinate context gathering, error diagnosis, and patch generation.
paragraphs.zh: 在独立基线中，RepairAgent 表现最佳，在 Pass@Tier-1 上达到 70.4%，在 Pass@Tier-2 上达到 64.5%，明显优于 APR-MCTS、Agentless 和 ThinkRepair。 这表明，结构化的工具使用对于 Rego 修复而言，远比单纯的提示或搜索更有效。 然而，RegoMender 大幅超越 RepairAgent，在 Pass@Tier-1 上高出 12.5%，在 Pass@Tier-2 上高出 13.4%。 这一差距表明，仅仅为单个智能体提供工具是不够的；成功的修复在很大程度上依赖于能够有效协调上下文收集、错误诊断和补丁生成的动态编排。

paragraphs.en: This reliance on proper orchestration becomes even clearer when comparing RegoMender with general-purpose agent systems. In contrast, RegoMender features a tailored orchestration mechanism that coordinates the Analyzer and Repairer according to repair progress, allowing the system to make suitable task decisions and resolve complex errors.
paragraphs.zh: 在将 RegoMender 与通用智能体系统进行比较时，这种对合理编排的依赖变得更加明显。 AutoDev 和 MetaGPT 等多智能体策略分别取得了 60.3% 和 53.9% 的 Pass@Tier-2 率。 现成的编码智能体表现更好，其中 Claude Code 达到 64.1%，Codex 达到 60.1%。 尽管如此，RegoMender 分别以 13.8% 和 17.8% 的优势超过了它们。 这些结果表明，通用系统在缺乏领域专用工作流的情况下难以处理链式 Rego 错误。 相比之下，RegoMender 具有定制的编排机制，能够根据修复进度协调分析器（Analyzer）与修复器（Repairer），使系统能够做出合适的任务决策并解决复杂错误。

paragraphs.en: To assess the reliability of JudgePass, three senior developers independently label a stratified sample of 300 Tier-2-passing repairs. After resolving disagreements, GPT-5.4 agrees with the final expert labels on 96.7% of the sampled repairs, with a Cohen’s κ \kappa ( Cohen, 1960 ) of 0.81. JudgePass remains close to Pass@Tier-2 across all evaluated methods, with differences ranging from 1.9% to 4.3%. For RegoMender, JudgePass reaches 76.0%, only 1.9% below its Pass@Tier-2 rate of 77.9%. This corresponds to approximately 97.6% of its Tier-2-passing repairs being judged to preserve the intended policy behavior. The strong agreement with expert labels supports the reliability of JudgePass, while the small gap between the two metrics supports the use of opa test as an executable proxy for Rego semantics.

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 compares the Pass@Tier-2 rates of all baselines across the seven defect types. paragraphs.en: In terms of stability, RegoMender achieves the lowest regression rate across all evaluated methods at just 7.7%. Claude Code has the lowest regression rate among the baselines at 13.5%, which is still 5.8% higher than RegoMender. This gap proves that our method rarely introduces more defects when modifying code. Regarding efficiency, RegoMender naturally requires more budgets ($8.7) and time (4.9h) than most baselines due to its multi-turn verification workflow. However, this added cost is a highly worthwhile trade-off. It directly translates into an absolute 13.4% improvement in overall Tier-2 success over the strongest baseline, making the moderate increase in effort entirely justified.

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows a complete chained repair case where hidden failures progressively emerge as verification advances. The buggy code first fails syntax parsing due to an unsupported rule syntax ( RG-PARSE-01 ), prompting an initial syntax migration to normalize the format. This migration then exposes a compilation blocker ( RG-REF-02 ). The policy imports an outdated helper namespace ( data.k8s.helpers ) that has moved to data.lib.k8s , causing an undefined reference. After resolving the dependency by importing the correct module, the verifier reveals a type usage issue ( RG-TYPE-03 ) where a boolean helper is incorrectly compared against a string literal (e.g., == "true" ). This error requires a rewrite into a boolean predicate. The resulting code passes all syntax checks, but semantic tests still fail with a security regression ( RG-SEM-04 ). Negative tests indicate the policy is missing a required non root enforcement rule, which would allow insecure pods. The repair completes only after adding the missing semantic constraint, namely a deny rule that enforces not k8s.runs_as_non_root(...) .

paragraphs.en: This scenario demonstrates why chained repair is fundamentally different from single-step editing. Early parsing and compilation failures can easily hide downstream type and security issues, and even a structurally sound policy can still fail semantic security tests. Accordingly, our framework strictly follows verification signals in the correct logical sequence. It progresses from syntax migration and dependency resolution, to type correction, and finally to a semantic patch. The framework continues iterating until the policy successfully passes all verification stages.

paragraphs.en: Based on the ablation study in Table 4 , we analyze the contribution of each tool to the overall repair success. The results identify Context Scan as the most critical tool. Its removal causes a severe decline in the success rate, dropping by 15.3% in the RepairAgent and 16.7% in the RegoMender. This decrease confirms that the primary challenge in Rego repair is resolving dependencies and import structures rather than merely fixing isolated syntax errors. Without scanning the broader context, the agent lacks the necessary information to understand the policy scope. Next in importance is the Patch tool, whose removal leads to a significant performance reduction of approximately 13%. This indicates that applying precise edits is more effective than rewriting entire code blocks, which can inadvertently introduce new defects. Without Rollback, RegoMender drops from 77.9% to 66.4%, a decrease of 11.5%. This result shows that Rollback helps the framework return to an earlier stable state when a repair attempt stalls or introduces new errors, preventing unsuccessful changes from affecting later repair steps. Furthermore, the exclusion of Error Triage and Rewrite results in performance losses of around 10%. This demonstrates the necessity of filtering raw compiler messages and providing a fallback for complex logic changes. Overall, the consistent performance drops across all ablation configurations validate that every tool in our framework is essential for achieving high-performance repair.

paragraphs.en: To investigate whether our framework generalizes beyond Rego, we expand our evaluation to include two other domain-specific languages, HCL and SQL, using their respective native oracles like tf fmt and standard SQL parsers. Applying the same filtering steps used for Rego, we collect 300 real-world HCL defects from 23 popular GitHub repositories and 100 SQL defects from 50 repositories.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究我们的框架能否推广到 Rego 之外，我们扩展了评估范围，纳入另外两种领域特定语言 HCL 和 SQL，并使用它们各自的原生 oracle，例如 tf fmt 和标准 SQL 解析器。 采用与 Rego 相同的过滤步骤，我们从 23 个热门 GitHub 仓库中收集了 300 个真实世界的 HCL 缺陷，并从 50 个仓库中收集了 100 个 SQL 缺陷。

sents.en: Applying the same filtering steps used for Rego, we collect 300 real-world HCL defects from 23 popular GitHub repositories and 100 SQL defects from 50 repositories.

paragraphs.en: Compared to Rego, both HCL and SQL offer clearer initial error messages, but they differ greatly in repair complexity. HCL is mainly used for cloud infrastructure. While its native tools easily point out the exact line of a syntax issue, a large portion of HCL defects cannot be repaired with a single change. Because infrastructure code is highly connected, fixing one resource often exposes an error in another, requiring multi-step repairs. In contrast, SQL queries are typically self-contained. Their defects are mostly simple syntax mistakes, like a missing keyword, which usually require only one local edit without cross-file dependencies. HCL and SQL provide a perfect testbed: HCL tests multi-step repairs with clear feedback, while SQL tests simple, single-step repairs.
paragraphs.zh: 与 Rego 相比，HCL 和 SQL 都能提供更清晰的初始错误信息，但二者在修复复杂度上差异很大。 HCL 主要用于云基础设施。 虽然其原生工具能够轻松指出语法问题的确切行号，但很大一部分 HCL 缺陷无法通过单次修改修复。 由于基础设施代码高度关联，修复一个资源常常会暴露另一个资源中的错误，因而需要多步修复。 相比之下，SQL 查询通常是自包含的。 其缺陷大多为简单的语法错误，例如缺少关键字，通常只需一次局部修改即可，不涉及跨文件依赖。 HCL 和 SQL 提供了一个理想的测试平台：HCL 用于测试反馈清晰的多步修复，而 SQL 用于测试简单的单步修复。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 indicates that the benefit of orchestration depends on the repair profile induced by the language and its oracle feedback, rather than remaining constant across DSLs. On HCL, RegoMender still outperforms RepairAgent (82.3% vs. 78.2%), suggesting that orchestration remains helpful when oracle feedback is relatively precise but the repair space is still more complex than SQL. On SQL, as defects are mostly lightweight parse failures and the oracle is simpler, both methods performed identically (84.0%).

paragraphs.en: To assess reliability in security critical scenarios, we evaluate the ThinkRepair, the RepairAgent, and RegoMender on 132 real-world vulnerabilities. We construct this specific subset by filtering RegoBench for instances linked to known CVE records.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估安全关键场景中的可靠性，我们在 132 个真实漏洞上对 ThinkRepair、RepairAgent 和 RegoMender 进行了评估。 我们通过筛选 RegoBench 中与已知 CVE 记录相关联的实例，构建了这个特定子集。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 presents repair performance across different Common Weakness Enumerations (CWEs). The results highlight that direct prompting is insufficient for security patches, solving only 26.6%. However, agentic workflows significantly improve these results. Compared to the 67.6% success rate of the RepairAgent, our method reaches 86.4%, delivering a clear 18.8% overall gain. Breaking down this overall improvement by vulnerability type reveals two key trends. First, RegoMender shows consistent improvements across major categories. It outperforms the RepairAgent by 15.6% in Access Control and 19.3% in Privilege Management. This advantage expands to 20.0% for Incorrect Authorization due to complex logic. Second, our method proves robust on diverse cases. It achieves a 40.0% performance boost in the Other category. This result confirms that a multi-agent system handles diverse vulnerability types much more effectively than a single agent.
paragraphs.zh: 表6展示了不同通用缺陷枚举（CWE）类型的修复性能。 结果表明，直接提示对于安全补丁而言是不够的，仅解决了26.6%。 然而，基于智能体的工作流显著改善了这些结果。 相比RepairAgent 67.6%的成功率，我们的方法达到了86.4%，带来了18.8%的总体提升。 按漏洞类型分解这一总体改进，可以揭示两个关键趋势。 首先，RegoMender在主要类别中展现出一致的改进。 它在访问控制类别中比RepairAgent高出15.6%，在权限管理类别中高出19.3%。 由于逻辑复杂，这一优势在授权错误类别中扩大到20.0%。 其次，我们的方法在多样化案例上证明了其鲁棒性。 它在其他类别中实现了40.0%的性能提升。 这一结果证实，多智能体系统在处理多样化漏洞类型方面远比单一智能体更有效。

paragraphs.en: To better understand the limitations of our approach, we present a qualitative analysis of failure instances where all evaluated methods failed to produce a valid repair.
paragraphs.zh: 为了更好地理解我们方法的局限性，我们对所有被评估方法均未能生成有效修复的失败案例进行了定性分析。

paragraphs.en: Unreachable Context. Failures often occur when project dependencies cannot be fully resolved. In complex projects, a file might rely on private modules, external code, or dynamically generated files. Since static analysis tools cannot access these missing parts, they provide an incomplete context. To fill these gaps, the model generates references or functions that look correct but are invalid. This keeps the system stuck in a loop of failed repair attempts, showing a limitation of relying solely on static analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 无法访问的上下文。 当项目依赖无法被完全解析时，故障常常发生。 在复杂项目中，一个文件可能依赖于私有模块、外部代码或动态生成的文件。 由于静态分析工具无法访问这些缺失的部分，它们提供的上下文是不完整的。 为了填补这些空白，模型会生成看起来正确但实际无效的引用或函数。 这使系统陷入修复尝试失败的循环中，表明了仅依赖静态分析的局限性。

paragraphs.en: Iteration Limitation. Beyond incomplete context, strict limits on repair iterations present another major hurdle. When a task involves multiple linked errors, fixing one bug often exposes another, creating a chain of issues that requires many attempts to fully resolve. Given the need to control costs, we set a maximum iteration limit, which can cause the RegoMender repair process to end just before the code is verified. Consequently, successfully repairing deeply interconnected errors under a strict iteration budget remains a major challenge.
paragraphs.zh: 迭代次数限制。 除上下文不完整之外，对修复迭代次数的严格限制是另一个主要障碍。 当任务涉及多个相互关联的错误时，修复一个缺陷往往会暴露出另一个缺陷，形成一连串问题，需要多次尝试才能彻底解决。 考虑到控制成本的需要，我们设定了最大迭代次数上限，这可能导致 RegoMender 修复过程在代码即将通过验证之前就提前结束。 因此，在严格的迭代次数预算下成功修复深度交织的错误仍然是一项重大挑战。

paragraphs.en: Semantic Ambiguity. Finally, failures can arise from coding conventions rather than simple syntax errors. A policy can be implemented in multiple valid ways, but only specific patterns align with the repository’s established style, such as the choice between deny and allow layouts. Without clear examples, the model may generate a patch that is technically correct but fails strict stylistic tests or is rejected during human review.

paragraphs.en: Internal Validity. One primary threat is that a repair may satisfy opa check and opa test while failing to fully preserve the original policy intent, particularly when test coverage is incomplete and misses edge cases. Another threat involves potential noise or data contamination in mined repair data, as commit histories may include refactoring or deletions unrelated to bug fixing. We mitigate these threats in two ways. paragraphs.en: Automated program repair has emerged as a promising technique to alleviate the manual debugging burden by automatically generating patches for software defects. Traditional APR methods typically rely on test suites as specifications and can be broadly categorized into search-based and constraint-based approaches. Search-based methods, such as GenProg ( Le Goues et al., 2012 ) and SimFix ( Jiang et al., 2018 ) , formulate patch generation as a search problem over a syntactic mutation space. Conversely, constraint-based approaches, like SemFix ( Nguyen et al., 2013 ) and Angelix ( Mechtaev et al., 2016 ) , leverage symbolic execution to extract program semantics and synthesize patches via constraint solving. While these traditional methods have demonstrated empirical success on general-purpose programming languages like Java and C, their efficacy is often bottlenecked by the exponential search space and the scalability limitations of underlying solvers.
paragraphs.zh: 自动程序修复已成为一种有前景的技术，通过自动为软件缺陷生成补丁来减轻人工调试的负担。 传统的 APR 方法通常依赖测试套件作为规约，并可大致分为基于搜索的方法和基于约束的方法。 基于搜索的方法，例如 GenProg（Le Goues 等，2012）和 SimFix（Jiang 等，2018），将补丁生成表述为在语法变异空间上的搜索问题。 相反，基于约束的方法，如 SemFix（Nguyen 等，2013）和 Angelix（Mechtaev 等，2016），利用符号执行提取程序语义，并通过约束求解合成补丁。 虽然这些传统方法在 Java 和 C 等通用编程语言上已展现出经验性的成功，但其有效性往往受限于指数级的搜索空间以及底层求解器的可扩展性限制。

paragraphs.en: In recent years, the rapid advancement of deep learning has catalyzed a paradigm shift towards learning-based APR. Early data-driven approaches ( Gupta et al., 2017 ; Tufano et al., 2019 ; Lutellier et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2021 ) treated patch generation as a Neural Machine Translation (NMT) task, learning bug-fixing patterns from large-scale historical commits. More recently, large language models pre-trained on massive code corpora have exhibited remarkable capabilities in understanding code context and generating plausible patches through methods like few-shot prompting ( Xia and Zhang, 2024 ; Yin et al., 2024 ; Kang et al., 2024 ) or fine-tuning ( Li et al., 2024 ) . These learning-based models have significantly improved the naturalness and correctness of generated patches, pushing the boundaries of automated debugging in modern software development ( Fan et al., 2023 ) .

paragraphs.en: Despite these improvements, existing APR methods primarily focus on general-purpose languages like Java or Python, leaving a significant gap in the realm of domain-specific languages and declarative policies. Recent studies have explored related tasks in infrastructure repair and policy generation. InfraFix ( Saavedra et al., 2025 ) repairs IaC scripts using verification rules designed for infrastructure configurations rather than Rego policies. ARPaCCino ( Romeo et al., 2026 ) generates Rego policies from natural-language requirements to address Terraform violations, while Prose2Policy ( Gupta and Sreenivasamurthy, 2026 ) translates natural-language access-control policies into executable Rego. Overall, these systems cover IaC repair and Rego synthesis, but do not address repository-level repair of existing faulty Rego policies using the OPA toolchain. Therefore, advancing APR in this domain requires novel frameworks designed specifically to capture the underlying logic and structural constraints of declarative policies.

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent Systems (MAS) have shown strong potential in software engineering ( Hu et al., 2025b ; Bouzenia et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2024 ; Islam et al., 2024 ; Becattini et al., 2025 ; Peng et al., 2025 ) by decomposing complex task into collaborative workflows ( He et al., 2025 ) . Existing systems generally follow two main design paradigms. The first is role-based collaboration, where agents are assigned specialized responsibilities resembling human development teams, such as planning, coding, and reviewing, as exemplified by systems like ChatDev ( Qian et al., 2024 ) and MetaGPT ( Hong et al., 2024 ) , which aim to improve modularity and coordination in large-scale development workflows. The second paradigm focuses on tool-integrated execution, where agents operate in sandboxed environments and interact directly with external tools and verification infrastructure to support end-to-end task execution ( Tufano et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体系统（MAS）在软件工程中展现出强大潜力（Hu et al., 2025b; Bouzenia et al., 2025; Huang et al., 2024; Islam et al., 2024; Becattini et al., 2025; Peng et al., 2025），其方式是将复杂任务分解为协作式工作流（He et al., 2025）。 现有系统普遍遵循两种主要设计范式。 第一种是基于角色的协作，即为智能体分配类似人类开发团队的专业职责，如规划、编码和审查，典型代表有 ChatDev（Qian et al., 2024）和 MetaGPT（Hong et al., 2024）等系统，它们旨在提升大规模开发工作流中的模块化与协调性。 第二种范式侧重于工具集成的执行方式，智能体在沙箱环境中运行，并直接与外部工具和验证基础设施交互，以支持端到端任务执行（Tufano et al., 2024; Yang et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2024; Wang et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: In the context of program repair, MAS naturally enables a division of labor by separating key stages such as fault localization, patch generation, and regression testing. It is often combined with search strategies to handle noisy or ambiguous feedback. However, existing MAS-based repair approaches still face significant challenges, particularly in terms of agent coordination and integration with external verifiers ( Cemri et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2026 ; Xia et al., 2024 ) . These challenges are even more pronounced in verification-intensive domains such as Policy-as-Code. In such cases, using MAS to separate diagnosis from oracle execution proves especially beneficial, as it enables a more auditable and reproducible repair loop, while also mitigating the brittleness commonly associated with Rego policy repair ( Open Policy Agent (OPA), ; Romeo et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we address the challenge of applying LLM-based repair to the strict reliability requirements of cloud-native Policy-as-Code. We focus on automated Rego repair, where success requires passing a rigorous verification toolchain rather than merely generating plausible code. Our experiments show that RegoMender consistently outperforms standalone baselines and general-purpose agent systems, especially on complex, multi-step defects and security-critical issues, while reducing the risk of introducing new bugs. These results suggest that, for domain-specific language repair, system architecture can be more important than model capability alone, especially when it effectively uses repository context and verifier feedback. RegoBench and RegoMender provide a foundation for building reliable autonomous DevSecOps agents.

paragraphs.en: Building on these findings, several directions merit exploration. First, expanding RegoBench to other Policy-as-Code languages would help assess the generality of our approach. Second, because production policies often depend on external modules and dynamic cluster states, combining static analysis with sandboxed execution could capture these dependencies and improve repair accuracy. Third, syntactically valid patches may still weaken security; automated negative tests and intent-preservation checks could prevent such repairs. Finally, future work should assess the cost–benefit trade-off of multi-agent collaboration for practical deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些发现的基础上，还有几个方向值得探索。 首先，将 RegoBench 扩展到其他策略即代码语言，有助于评估我们方法的普适性。 其次，由于生产环境的策略往往依赖外部模块和动态集群状态，将静态分析与沙箱执行相结合可以捕获这些依赖关系，从而提高修复准确率。 第三，语法上有效的补丁仍可能削弱安全性；自动化负面测试和意图保持检查可以防止此类修复。 最后，未来的工作应评估多智能体协作在实际部署中的成本效益权衡。
